cards.text: This psalm is from David, the shepherd who became king of Israel. And who's the first one he preaches to? HIMSELF: "Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name."
David tells his soul to bless the LORD again. Friend, that's a man giving himself a HALFTIME pep talk, and this time he adds something his soul is NOT allowed to do.

cards.question: David tells his soul to bless the LORD. What does he tell his soul NOT to do?

answers.text: Grow tired of waiting on Him

cards.text: So David starts listing those kind deeds, talking right to his soul. And he opens with the big ones.

cards.question: David reminds his soul that the LORD ___ all your iniquities and ___ all your diseases.

cards.text: And the list keeps coming. The LORD redeems your life from the Pit, and friend, a stamper who got pulled out of a dark drawer knows EXACTLY how good that sounds.

cards.question: David says the LORD redeems your life from the Pit. Then He crowns you. With what?
David says the LORD satisfies you with good things. What does David say happens to your youth?

answers.text: It is renewed like the eagle's
It is spent like a passing wind
It is kept like a hidden treasure

cards.text: Then David zooms out past his own soul. He says the LORD executes righteousness and justice.

cards.question: David says the LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
David says the LORD made His deeds known to the people of Israel. Who did He make His ways known to?
David says the LORD is compassionate and gracious, ___ to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

cards.text: Slow to anger. Friend, I have NOT been slow to anger with an oven timer that went off early, but the LORD will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.

cards.question: David says the LORD has not repaid us according to our iniquities.

cards.text: Now David reaches for pictures, and his first one is as high as the heavens are above the earth. Friend, I measure things in TEASPOONS, and David is out here measuring in SKY.

cards.question: David says something about the LORD is as great as the heavens are high above the earth. What is it?

answers.text: His loving devotion for those who fear Him
His anger toward those who turn from Him
The distance between Him and His people

cards.question: David's next picture is as far as the east is from the west. What has the LORD removed from us that far?
David says the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him, the way a ___ has compassion on his children.
David says the LORD forgets what we are made of.

cards.text: He knows our frame. He is mindful that we are dust, and friend, after years in the back of a drawer, I can tell you dust is NOT a flex.
Then David looks at how short a person's days are. He says man's days are like grass, and he blooms like a flower of the field.

cards.question: David says that when the wind passes over the flower of the field, it grows back stronger.

cards.text: It vanishes, and its place remembers it no more. Friend, I KNOW that one: they slid me into the drawer, wiped the counter once, and it was like I was never there.

cards.question: Next to that flower that vanishes, how long does David say the LORD's loving devotion extends to those who fear Him?

answers.text: For as long as they live

cards.question: David says the LORD's righteousness reaches all the way to the children's children of those who fear Him.

cards.text: That's for those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts. Then David looks up.

cards.question: David says the LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over ___.

cards.text: Now David turns from his own soul and calls out to others to bless the LORD. And he starts with some heavy hitters.

cards.question: Who does David call to bless the LORD, the ones mighty in strength who carry out His word?

cards.text: Then he calls all His hosts, the servants who do His will, and all His works in all places of His dominion. Friend, David just hit REPLY ALL on the whole universe.

"Bless the LORD, O my soul!" After calling in the whole universe, David turns right back and points at his own soul, and friend, that's me rallying the whole bakery and then going, "YOU too, mustache."

findings.problem: The card adds the outside-passage facts that David was a shepherd and became king of Israel, but Psalm 103:1 supports neither fact and no other reference is given for them.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: Moses appears for the first time only as a bare answer choice, and no card simply explains who he is.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The claim that they "wiped the counter once" after sliding him into the drawer adds a new event to the Millers' kitchen backstory. It is not a small invented moment around his bakery.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.
